items.title: An affine morphism is local complete intersection exactly when its ring map is

items.difficulty_reason: For f : X = Spec(B) -> S = Spec(A) a morphism of affine schemes, f is a local complete intersection morphism if and only if A -> B is a local complete intersection homomorphism (in the sense of the cited More on Algebra definition, reproduced by label in the statement itself). The retained proof is 'Follows immediately from the definitions' — the schemes lci notion is defined by local factorizations into a regular immersion followed by an etale map, and on the single affine chart those factorizations translate verbatim into the standard factorization definition of an lci ring map; no further argument is written by the author. Retained author proof at lines 18186-18188.
